welcome.title: Welcome to AdMeNot
welcome.lead: Before you start, read what you are agreeing to.
welcome.risk1: AdMeNot is a beta and may contain bugs.
welcome.risk2: The program disables and removes apps on the customer's phone. Every change is your decision, and you answer for it to the customer.
welcome.risk3: You can undo most changes in History. Removing an app deletes its data — undo restores at most the app itself from the APK copy.
welcome.risk4: Back up the customer's important data before a repair.
welcome.risk5: The program is provided “as is”, without any warranty (PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 license).
welcome.later: You can change your choices at any time in Settings.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.telemetry_hint: They show which phones reach repair shops and whether detection gets it right. No serial numbers, IMEI or customer data.
privacy.packages: Include package names of flagged and removed apps
privacy.packages_hint: This helps improve detection the most. The name of a rare app may, however, say something about the customer.

what.common: Always: a random installation ID, program and Windows version, language, hour of the event.
what.start: Program start (at most once a day): simple or expert mode.
what.scan: After a scan: phone manufacturer, model and Android version, number of apps per rating, scan time, APK analysis result.
what.repair: After a repair: how many apps were silenced, disabled and removed, how many the program flagged, how many failed and the error codes.
what.undo: After an undo: how many apps were restored and how many days after the repair.
what.transfer_backup: After copying an old phone's data: phone manufacturer, model and Android version, outcome, duration, size in MB, number of copied and failed files and apps, which kinds of data were selected — no folder, file or app names.
what.transfer_restore: After uploading a copy to a new phone: the new phone's manufacturer, model and Android version, outcome, duration, size in MB, numbers of files uploaded, already present, saved alongside, refused by Android, failed, skipped and missing from the copy, number of skipped APK files (harmful and suspicious), number of parallel transfers, how files were checked, whether the gallery was refreshed, which kinds of files were selected. When apps were installed too: the same numbers and error codes as in the app install event below — no folder, file or app names.
what.transfer_apps: After installing apps from a copy on a new phone (also when finishing them later): the new phone's manufacturer, model and Android version, numbers of apps selected, installed, already present, skipped and failed, counts of install errors by error code only, whether they were installed as from the Play Store and whether the phone blocked installation over USB — no app or package names.
what.transfer_report: When the handover report is created: its overall outcome (all fine, warnings or problems) and whether WhatsApp was marked as restored — no customer details or order number.
what.explorer: After closing the file explorer: the phone's manufacturer, model and Android version, duration, number and size in MB of files copied to the computer and uploaded to the phone, median speed, number of previews (photos, videos, audio, text), number of folders and text files created, number of errors by code — no folder or file names and no paths.
what.packages: With the second consent: package names of apps the program flagged or you selected, with the rating and your decision.
what.never: Never: serial number, IMEI, customer name, order number, shop details, screenshots, names of apps rated safe and left untouched.

privacy.id_hint: Include it in an email if you want your data deleted. Turning statistics off deletes the data from the server.
privacy.delete_pending: Deleting data from the server is waiting for an internet connection.

transfer.xiaomi_hint: On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones, turn on “USB debugging (Security settings)” in Developer options, then choose “Copy data” again. If the copy is already done, select only the missing data, e.g. SMS and contacts — the rest does not need to be copied again.

restore.sub: Copy of {phone} ({details}). I will not overwrite or delete anything.
restore.same_title: This is the phone the copy was made from

restore.incomplete_text: Missing from the copy: {list}. What is in it will be uploaded.

note.whatsapp: WhatsApp files — chats are restored in the app

restore.apks_note: App installers from the copy, assessed on this computer. Harmful ones are never uploaded.

tel.duplicates: the phone already has contacts — duplicates are possible
tel.todo_file: install SMS Backup & Restore, tap Restore and choose the file {name} from Downloads
tel.todo_contacts: open Contacts → Import and pick {name} from Downloads

tap.grant: On the phone: confirm AdMeNot as the SMS app for the upload
tap.grant_text: Without it, messages go to a file for manual import.
tap.restore: On the phone: choose {app} as the default SMS app
tap.restore_text: The phone must go back to its previous SMS app — this step cannot be skipped.

cleanup.running: Restoring the phone's settings after an interrupted upload…
cleanup.running_text: Scanning and data transfer will be available when this finishes.
cleanup.failed: The phone did not return to its settings
cleanup.failed_text: On the phone open Settings → Apps → Default apps → SMS app and choose {app}. Then uninstall AdMeNot Helper (Settings → Apps).

restore.apps_note: without data — each one needs signing in again
restore.xiaomi_label: Xiaomi blocks installation · how to enable?
restore.xiaomi_how: How to enable: Settings → Additional settings → Developer options → “Install via USB” (Xiaomi may ask you to sign in to a Mi account). I will check by myself once you do. Without it I upload the rest and skip the apps.
restore.safety: Before uploading I will make a safety backup of the new phone.
restore.space_label: Used space and files to upload
restore.no_space: {size} short on the new phone — untick some of the data
restore.uploading: Uploading files to the new phone
restore.uploading_sub: Don't disconnect the phone. If the cable comes loose, the upload waits and then continues.
restore.waiting: Phone disconnected — reconnect it and the upload will continue
restore.done_stopped_text: Uploaded files stay on the phone. To finish, connect this phone and choose “Resume” next to the copy.
restore.restart: restart the phone so the gallery sees the files

issue.tel_failed: not everything could be uploaded in contacts and messages
issue.tel_error: contacts and messages could not be uploaded
issue.scan: the gallery may not see the files until the phone restarts
issue.blocked: apps are waiting for Xiaomi to allow install via USB
issue.safety: the backup of the new phone failed
issue.apps_error: the apps could not be installed

res.import_sub: the phone would not let me write them — I prepared a file to import
res.apps_running: installing the apps skipped because of the Xiaomi block…

wa.title: WhatsApp
wa.installed: The chat backup is on the phone. Open WhatsApp, sign in with the customer's number and choose “Restore” (the backup password may be needed).
wa.missing: The chat backup is on the phone. Install WhatsApp from Google Play, sign in with the customer's number and choose “Restore” (the backup password may be needed).
wa.pre_installed: WhatsApp was already on the phone — if it had been opened, restoring may need it to be reinstalled.
wa.check: Chats restored — note it in the report

restore.apps_consent: If the phone asks for permission, confirm it

apps_why.no_space: not enough space on the phone
apps_why.version_downgrade: the phone has a newer version

restore.xiaomi_how_done: How to enable: Settings → Additional settings → Developer options → “Install via USB” (Xiaomi may ask you to sign in to a Mi account). I will check by myself once you do and install the skipped apps.

sum.missing: missing from the copy on this computer: {count}

error.transfer_wrong_device: A different phone is connected than the one being uploaded to. Connect the right phone and choose “Upload” again — uploaded files stay.
error.transfer_too_many_disconnects: The phone disconnected too often. Check the cable and choose “Upload” again — uploaded files stay.
error.transfer_failed: The upload failed. Try again — files already uploaded stay on the phone.

error.retired: This version of AdMeNot is withdrawn — changes to phones are blocked until you update.
error.adb_missing: The adb program was not found. Point to adb.exe in the settings.
error.unauthorized: The phone is not authorized — confirm the prompt on the phone.
error.offline: The phone is offline — reconnect the cable.
error.timeout: The phone did not answer in time.
error.busy: Another task is running — wait for it to finish.
error.wrong_device: Connect the {device}, which this order is for.
error.device_mismatch: This is not the {device} from this order — another phone with the same serial number, or the phone after a factory reset. Changes from this order will not be made or undone on this phone.
error.no_device: Connect and scan a phone first.
error.nothing_to_resume: This order has no steps left to finish.
error.nothing_to_do: Nothing to run — the selected apps are blocked.
error.plan_changed: The plan has changed since it was shown to the client. Show the client the new code.
error.no_target: No such app or step in the order.
error.logo_missing: The logo file does not exist.
error.logo_type: The logo must be a PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG file.
error.logo_size: The logo is too large (1 MB limit).
error.mirror_missing: Bundled scrcpy is missing — run scripts\fetch_tools.py.
error.mirror_failed: Could not start the screen view.
error.shot_limit: You can choose at most 8 screenshots for the report.
error.device_busy: Another AdMeNot window or the CLI is running an order on this phone. Wait until it finishes.
error.data_too_new: The program data comes from a newer version of AdMeNot — update the program.
error.transfer_no_inventory: The phone from the copy screen is no longer connected. Connect it and choose “Copy data” again.
error.transfer_disk_full: Not enough disk space on this computer. Free up space and start the copy again — files already copied stay.
error.transfer_wrong_device: A different phone is connected than the one being copied. Connect the right phone and start the copy again.
error.transfer_too_many_disconnects: The phone disconnected too often. Check the cable and start the copy again — files already copied stay.
error.transfer_failed: The copy failed. Files already copied stay — start the copy again.
error.transfer_in_use: A file of this copy is open in another program (e.g. File Explorer or a photo viewer). Close it and try again.
error.transfer_phone_full: The new phone ran out of space. Free up space or untick some of the data and choose “Upload” — uploaded files stay.
error.transfer_copy_missing: This copy is no longer on this computer (it was deleted or moved).
error.transfer_no_plan: The phone from the upload screen is no longer connected. Connect it and choose the copy again.
error.explorer_busy: Another operation is running on this phone — open the files when it ends.
error.explorer_offline: The phone is not responding — check the cable.
error.explorer_denied: The phone does not allow this in this folder.
error.explorer_missing: This file or folder is no longer on the phone.
error.explorer_exists: A file or folder with this name is already here.
error.explorer_bad_name: This name cannot be used — no “/”, not “.” or “..”, at most 255 bytes.
error.explorer_not_open: The file explorer is already closed.
error.explorer_no_dest: The destination folder is not on this computer (e.g. a removed USB drive) — pick another one.
error.explorer_not_folder: This folder is no longer on this computer.
